rawContent: We keep saying #BlackLivesMatter because when it gets awkward, so many people behave as if they don’t believe it. Not when those lives are continually shown to not be considered valuable by the people who have badges and guns and are way too at ease with killing Blacks folks.

(Side note: whenever there’s any kind of mass media social action, there are assholes who will intentionally flood typo hashtags to fuck with Twitter’s autocomplete.)

It’s #BlackLivesMatter

Not #BlackLivesMatters or #BlackLiveMatter or #BlackLiveMatters or
#BlackLifesMatter

tl;dr - if you’re posting in support of #BlackLivesMatter and you have the time, make sure you type out the whole hashtag. Tell your friends to do the same.

These assholes rely on overwhelming numbers of fake tags to mess with the system. Drown their asses out.
